scripts.lint: bun run --filter @your-shadow/web lint && bun run --filter @your-shadow/api lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run contracts:build && bun run contracts:typecheck && bun run --filter @your-shadow/web typecheck && bun run --filter @your-shadow/api typecheck
scripts.test: bun run contracts:build && bun run --filter @your-shadow/api test
scripts.test:e2e: bun run contracts:build && bun run --filter @your-shadow/api test:e2e
scripts.build: bun run contracts:build && bun run --filter @your-shadow/web build && bun run --filter @your-shadow/api build
scripts.db:migration:create: cd apps/api && bun run typeorm migration:create
scripts.db:migration:generate: cd apps/api && bun run typeorm migration:generate -d src/database/typeorm.data-source.ts
scripts.db:migration:run: cd apps/api && bun run typeorm migration:run -d src/database/typeorm.data-source.ts
scripts.db:migration:show: cd apps/api && bun run typeorm migration:show -d src/database/typeorm.data-source.ts
scripts.db:migration:revert: cd apps/api && bun run typeorm migration:revert -d src/database/typeorm.data-source.ts
